explanation: Walk to the node immediately before the selected non-head position, then bypass the selected node. All retained nodes preserve their values and identities.
timeComplexity: O(node_idx): walk to the predecessor of the zero-based deletion position and perform one bypass.
spaceComplexity: O(1): the predecessor traversal needs one pointer and the bypass allocates no nodes.
attribution: JavaScript port of the independently authored EPI Practice C# algorithm; no upstream reference code copied.
correctness: The traversal stops at the predecessor of the requested zero-based position. Replacing its Next with the selected node’s Next removes exactly that node while preserving the order and values of every retained node.
walkthrough: For [7,5,9,2] and position 2, walk to node 5 and point it directly to node 2. The returned list is [7,5,2].
edgeCases: The supplied position is at least one.
Deleting the tail simply sets its predecessor’s Next to null.
This exercise does not select the head.
